paragraphs: Friend, this passage hands us one truth to stand on: Jesus really died, and Jesus really rose. Pilate had the centurion confirm that Jesus was already dead (Mark 15:44-45), and Joseph laid His body in a tomb and rolled a stone against the entrance (Mark 15:46). Then the young man in the white robe says, "He has risen! He is not here!" (Mark 16:6). That's the center of everything, and it's why the rest of the Bible is good news for you.

The women came with spices, expecting a closed tomb and asking who would roll away the stone (Mark 16:1-3). But when they looked up, the stone was already rolled away, even though it was extremely large (Mark 16:4). I think that shows the resurrection doesn't wait for us to have everything figured out. And friend, I have lost WHOLE nights of sleep over worries that were already handled before I got there.

Then the young man sends the women to the disciples and Peter with this message: "He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you" (Mark 16:7). Jesus keeps His word, and He goes ahead of His people. The women ran away trembling and said nothing in their fear (Mark 16:8), and that tells me you can be scared and still be standing on solid ground. The story isn't over, friend, so keep your apron on.
